annotations.exact_quote: symmetric graph regularization framework for pairwise constraint propagation
annotations.reason_zh: 论文核心任务，提出对称图正则化框架进行成对约束传播，并扩展must-link和cannot-link约束。

annotations.exact_quote: quadratic optimization with symmetric graph regularization
annotations.reason_zh: 使用对称图正则化作为二次优化的一部分，对子问题学习结果施加图几何一致性约束。

annotations.exact_quote: The propagated constraints are further used to adjust the similarity between data points
annotations.reason_zh: 传播后的约束被用于修正数据点间的相似度/亲和矩阵，属于图结构学习。

annotations.exact_quote: our method can directly be applied to multi-class problem and also can effectively exploit both must-link and cannot-link constraints
annotations.reason_zh: 利用must-link和cannot-link成对约束这一有限监督信息指导多类问题，符合半监督学习中以有限成对约束指导全部样本学习的设定。

annotations.exact_quote: The propagated constraints are further used to adjust the similarity between data points so that they can be incorporated into subsequent clustering.
annotations.reason_zh: 方法将已有 must-link/cannot-link 关系传播后指导聚类，研究以不完整关系监督替代充分实例真值的弱监督条件。
